description: This file implements MKLDNN (oneDNN) optimized RNN operations for PyTorch, including layer and backward functions, with conditional compilation depending on MKLDNN support. It defines structures and functions for RNN parameter handling, weight/bias shuffling, and dispatching to MKLDNN primitives.

classes.name: RNNParams
classes.description: Structure encapsulating parameters and memory descriptors for MKLDNN RNN operations.

methods.name: mkldnn_rnn_layer
methods.description: Performs MKLDNN-accelerated RNN layer computation; raises error if MKLDNN support is disabled.

methods.name: mkldnn_rnn_layer_backward
methods.description: Performs backward pass for MKLDNN RNN layer; raises error if MKLDNN support is disabled.

methods.name: mkldnn_rnn
methods.description: Executes MKLDNN RNN primitive for inference or training.

methods.name: unpack_hidden
methods.description: Unpacks hidden state tuple into individual tensors.

methods.name: pack_hidden
methods.description: Packs hidden state tensors into the appropriate structure.

methods.name: mkldnn_impl
methods.description: Template function dispatching MKLDNN RNN primitive based on hidden state type.

methods.name: lstm_mkldnn
methods.description: Wrapper function calling mkldnn_impl for LSTM, registered as dispatch.
